Both captures preserve new and returning buyer flow. Desktop QR and mobile app selection/redirect route to the banking/wallet authentication and approval step. A new buyer supplies information and is signed up to Link after transaction completion; returning Link users have saved name, address and virtual payment address. Storage and return/notification do not by themselves establish payment or merchant settlement (old 27-47; new 40-60).

Refund and dispute text is semantically unchanged (old 49-55; new 62-68). Source lines 24-31 correctly preserve timing, events and failure recovery but should name the final `Refund` states and attach merchant debit explicitly to an accepted bank/PSP dispute request. substantive_changes: The November Link-specific floor is 0.50 USD equivalent in INR, replacing May's 1 INR. Both keep the INR 100,000 maximum and INR presentment (new 33-38 versus old 20-25).

November adds an email interest/access request route (new 15-25), while the US availability banner and eligible US business language remain. The request is not activation and does not by itself say UPI on Link is universally private-preview-only.
historical_claims_to_preserve: May's 1 INR floor remains dated. Link auto-enable is always qualified by seller onboarding, restrictions, method eligibility and named UI scope. Preserve neither global Link access nor guaranteed session display from the auto-enable wording (old 14-25; new 27-38).

May and November preserve one-time on-session, bank/wallet authentication, and the new/returning Link distinction (old 7-25, 27-47; new 8-13, 27-60). Stored personal details do not constitute recurring authorization.

On `succeeded` refund is successful; `failed` returns funds to Stripe balance and calls for an alternate refund. Bank/PSP dispute acceptance drives immediate non-contestable Stripe debit (old 49-55; new 62-68).

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/upi`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/upi describes UPI on Link for eligible onboarded US businesses outside restricted categories, for one-time, on-session payments presented in INR. Turn on Link for automatic UPI enablement subject to eligibility, on Payment Links, hosted Checkout or Elements. November changes the minimum to 0.50 USD equivalent in INR, keeps the INR 100,000 maximum, and adds an email request route that does not establish granted access (new raw lines 15-38 and old raw lines 14-25). Desktop uses a QR; mobile lists UPI apps and redirects to the selected app. Banking or wallet app authorization is required. The illustrated new buyer supplies information and signs up once the transaction completes; returning buyers have saved name, address and virtual payment address. Return or notification alone does not establish merchant settlement (new raw lines 40-60 and old raw lines 27-47). The separate November Link payment-methods guide groups UPI with Pix as `lfsg_002`. The Dashboard shows the Link-as-payment-method representation as type `link`, with the group at `Charge.payment_method_details.link.funding_source_group`. It shows the card-specific representation as type `card` with `brand=link`, with the group at `Charge.payment_method_details.card.wallet.link.funding_source_group`. Neither Link branding nor the shared group identifies the underlying payment as UPI or proves payment completion (raw/stripe-payments-link-link-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md:17-42). Refund requests are allowed up to 60 days and complete asynchronously, up to seven business days. `refund.updated` or `refund.failed` report final `Refund` status. `succeeded` and `failed` differ; failure returns the amount to the Stripe balance and requires another refund method. If the customer's bank or PSP accepts their request to return funds, the merchant cannot contest and Stripe immediately removes funds (new raw lines 62-68 and old raw lines 49-55). source-stripe-upi-on-link.md preserves the main flow but its 1 INR minimum is May-specific.

The 100,000 INR maximum, eligible US merchant scope, one-time on-session INR use and only three UI routes persist (old raw lines 14-25 and new raw lines 15-38). Rewording and numbering the customer steps and changing refund webhook formatting are presentational. Preserve the dated approved scope, saved details, 60-day submission and seven-business-day asynchronous completion, final Refund states and conditional bank/PSP dispute debit in source-stripe-upi-on-link.md (old raw lines 27-55 and new raw lines 40-68). Update the reciprocal Link concept/index and company navigation floor and distinguish the separate direct UPI 1 INR limit and AutoPay mandate from UPI on Link. May's general Link overview explicitly excludes India in its Stripe account business-location section (raw/stripe-link-2025.md:56-58). The November general Link overview says Link is unavailable in India without explicitly restating that account-location qualifier (raw/stripe-payments-link-2026-11-07.md:15-17). Keep those dated statements distinct from the dedicated UPI on Link route for eligible US businesses presenting in INR (new raw lines 27-38), and from direct UPI's India customer context (raw/stripe-payments-upi-2026-11-07.md:13-23). These captures do not settle a blanket geography rule for buyers on the dedicated Link route. The separate November Link payment-methods guide groups UPI with Pix as `lfsg_002`. Neither Link branding nor the shared group identifies the underlying payment as UPI or proves payment completion (raw/stripe-payments-link-link-payment-methods-2026-11-07.md:17-42). This is separate companion evidence; it adds no substantive delta to the dedicated UPI on Link pair. The interest form, QR, return and refund submission do not themselves establish access, verified payment success, buyer bank credit or payout.
